records.rationale: Full two-path unique remerge diff read, including both include-conflict resolutions. It retains PR_SET_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH and the Android PR_SET_VMA constants simultaneously and combines required includes. Both interfaces and constants are now native LTS: entire UAPI header equals LTS, prctl_set_vma equals LTS and the complete prctl syscall equals LTS after the separately audited finished notification. linux/mm.h and syscall_user_dispatch.h are present; obsolete mempolicy include is not needed by native implementation and is not restored. No old VMA-name storage implementation is introduced by this merge decision. Native validation and permissions remain; runtime prctl behavior unverified.
